title: ESP32 Project Configuration
description: Central configuration for project metadata and board definitions. Edit project.json to add/remove boards or rename the project.

name.description: Short project identifier used in firmware build flags, manifests, and release titles

description.description: Human-readable project description shown in web installer and README

installer.description: Web installer UI configuration. All fields drive docs/index.html via the generated window.PROJECT_CONFIG.

h1.description:
Main heading text. May contain a literal
for a line break.

subtitle.description: Subtitle paragraph shown below the h1.

baseUrl.description: GitHub Pages base URL used for manifest fetching. No trailing slash.

githubUrl.description: GitHub repository URL shown in the footer.

badgeText.description: Small badge label in the page header. Defaults to 'Web Installer' if omitted.

branding.description: Optional social/support links shown in the web installer footer and README. Fork-friendly: replace these with your own links.

icon.description: Emoji icon displayed before the link label

boards.description: All supported target boards. Each entry drives the CI build matrix, platformio.ini env sections, and the web installer board list.

id.description: PlatformIO environment name. Used in firmware filenames: firmware-{id}-{version}.bin. Must be lowercase with underscores.

name.description: Human-readable board name shown in the web installer and release notes

chip.description: esptool chip name passed to esptool.py --chip

chipFamily.description: ESP Web Tools chipFamily value used in manifest.json builds[].chipFamily

bootloaderOffset.description: Bootloader flash offset passed to esptool merge_bin. Use '0x0' for C3/S3/C6 chips, '0x1000' for classic ESP32 (esp32dev).

platform.description: PlatformIO platform string or zip URL. Use 'espressif32' for standard chips, or a zip URL for unofficial forks (e.g. pioarduino for ESP32-C6).

platformioBoard.description: PlatformIO board ID (the 'board =' value in platformio.ini). Usually matches 'id' but may differ (e.g. generic_esp32 uses esp32dev).

buildFlag.description: C preprocessor #define symbol injected as -D {buildFlag} in platformio.ini build_flags. Use SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.

partitionsFile.description: Custom partition table CSV filename (relative to PlatformIO project root), or null to use the platform default.

requiresUv.description: Set true if the platform requires 'pip install uv' before building. Needed for pioarduino-based platforms (e.g. ESP32-C6).

icon.description: Single emoji displayed next to the board name in the web installer UI

meta.description: Short descriptor shown below the board name in the web installer (e.g. chip · arch · flash size)
